## TemplateEngine.\_processGPollBlocks() method

Block: g-poll Extracts and parses `<g-poll>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGPollBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: IPollBlock;
    };
```

**Returns:**

An object mapping language keys to their poll configurations

## Remarks

Each block declares one poll per language (`lang` defaults to `"default"`<!-- -->; last block wins per lang). The inner `<g-question>` becomes `question`<!-- -->, each inner `<g-option>` becomes one entry of `options`<!-- -->. `type` defaults to `"regular"`<!-- -->; `correct` is parsed to a 0-based index when numeric; `anonymous` defaults to `true`<!-- -->. Structural rules (exactly one question, 2–10 options, quiz/regular coherence) are enforced by `validateBlockGPollAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const polls = TemplateEngine._processGPollBlocks(`<g-poll type="quiz" correct="1"><g-question>Q?</g-question><g-option>A</g-option><g-option>B</g-option></g-poll>`);
// Result: { default: { type: 'quiz', question: 'Q?', options: ['A', 'B'], correct: 1, anonymous: true } }
```
